item.title: A Normal(0, 10) prior on a logistic coefficient is not weak — it is a confident bet on certainty
item.dc:creator: Batesthommie
item.description: Priors are chosen on the log-odds scale and interpreted as vague. Pushed through the inverse logit, a wide Normal prior puts most of its mass on probabilities of essentially 0 or essentially 1.
